subject: KernerHealth secure deployment discovery & evidence requests
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <security@kernerhealth.com>, Jamie Park <cto@kernerhealth.com>
Cc: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-25T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: KernerHealth secure deployment discovery & next steps

Thanks for the call today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track items.

Recap (30-min discovery):
- KernerHealth is assessing a private deployment for PHI workloads (primary region: us-west).
- Key requirements: HIPAA BAA, strict egress controls, network isolation (VPC + customer-managed firewall), occasional offline/islanded mode for certain workflows.
- Compliance posture: you mentioned SOC 2 is in progress and that some EU patient data may be in scope — we should confirm GDPR applicability.

Asks / next actions:
1) Can you confirm current SOC 2 status (type, expected completion)?
2) HIPAA: confirm whether a signed BAA will be required and any specific legal points to highlight.
3) Please attach your vendor security questionnaire (if you have a preferred template) — I can pre-fill what we can.
4) For technical scoping: we need a simple network diagram showing where Kerner would place Redwood (VPC/On‑prem), firewall/NAT boundaries, and whether a true air‑gapped setup is required for the most sensitive workloads.

I'll loop in Monica (security) and Rohan (solutions) to prepare our SOC2 summary, a BAA draft, and two reference diagrams (VPC with strict egress + air‑gapped option). If you can attach the questionnaire and any internal network docs that would be ideal.

Timing: aiming to get initial documents to you within 48 hours (target: 2028-07-27).

Thanks — Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0143

From: Alex Chen <security@kernerhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Park <cto@kernerhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KernerHealth secure deployment discovery & next steps

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers and notes below.

1) SOC 2: We are currently SOC 2 Type I (controls in place) and have a Type II audit in progress; target completion Q4 2028. We can share a current SOC 2 Type I letter and the SOC 2 roadmap.
2) HIPAA: Yes, a BAA will be required for PHI workloads. Our legal team will want standard terms; if you have your BAA template please share.
3) Questionnaire: attaching our standard vendor questionnaire (kerner-vendor-v1.docx) — it includes network, encryption, personnel, and penetration testing sections.
4) Isolation: preferred initial deployment is private VPC with customer-managed subnets and strict egress rules (deny by default, allow specific outbound endpoints); for highly sensitive workflows we will evaluate an air‑gapped model where data is processed in a physically isolated cluster (no outbound internet).

Attachments: kerner-vendor-v1.docx

Additional: our infra contact for network diagrams is me (security@kernerhealth.com). For legal/contracting, loop in contracts@kernerhealth.com.

Please send: Redwood SOC artifacts (summary), BAA draft, and a short checklist of firewall rules and required customer NAT/route table settings. Also example diagrams for both VPC and air‑gapped on‑prem patterns — those will help our architects.

Best,
Alex Chen
Senior InfoSec Engineer, Kerner Health
security@kernerhealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-25T18:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: KernerHealth secure deployment discovery & next steps

Monica / Rohan — forwarding Kerner's reply and attached questionnaire. Quick ask: can security produce the following artifacts by 2028-07-28 EOD so we can get them back to Kerner within 48 hours?

Requested deliverables:
- Redwood SOC2 summary (one-pager) + current Type I letter (redwood-soc2-summary-2028.pdf).
- BAA template for review (redwood-baa-template-2028.docx).
- VPC reference diagram showing recommended subnet layout, NAT/egress points, and minimal outbound ACLs.
- Air‑gapped/on‑prem reference diagram (vpc-airgap-reference-diagram.png) and a short runbook for how egress will be blocked and how updates are delivered.
- Firewall checklist (redwood-vpc-firewall-checklist.xlsx) with ports/hosts we need open for management/updates if applicable.

Kerner attached their questionnaire (kerner-vendor-v1.docx). They also asked for a list of data flows showing where PHI is stored vs ephemeral in RAM/KV cache. Add that to the deliverables if possible.

I'll own communication back to Alex once we have the artifacts. Let me know if any of these are blocked.

Thanks — Karthik

--- Forwarded attachment: kerner-vendor-v1.docx (survey)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-26T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: KernerHealth secure deployment discovery & next steps

Got it — will take lead. Plan / owners: 
- SOC2 summary + Type I letter: Monica Patel (I will pull the latest summary and redact where needed). Target: 2028-07-26 COB.
- BAA draft: Legal + Monica to produce redwood-baa-template-2028.docx. Target: 2028-07-28 EOD.
- VPC diagram + air-gap variant: Rohan Mehta to produce two PNGs (VPC_strict_egress.png, airgap_reference.png) and a short runbook describing update mechanics. Target: 2028-07-28 EOD.
- Firewall checklist & dataflow table: Monica to draft initial redwood-vpc-firewall-checklist.xlsx + dataflow_summary.csv. Target: 2028-07-27 EOD.

I'll also start filling Kerner's questionnaire for the sections we control and mark items that need legal input. I'll upload all artifacts to the shared drive link and attach daily progress notes in this thread.

Related: I'll open Jira ticket SUP-2145 to track evidence items and share with Kerner if they want a ticket to follow progress.

Attachments (will attach to next outbound email): redwood-soc2-summary-2028.pdf; redwood-baa-template-2028.docx; vpc-airgap-reference-diagram.png; redwood-vpc-firewall-checklist.xlsx

Monica
